Unexplained = total minus the available disjoint intervals. JSON rows retain each uncovered span's exact endpoint fields.
Participant reply uses reply_index; later replies include room follow-ups and probes. Sim summaries use the earliest played reply even when reply 0 has no ACK. Encounter reply separates the first reply at start, the first after each 1:1 handoff, and later replies.
Each stage uses its own available replies. Mean shares with different share_n values need not sum to 100%. Missing intervals are unavailable. Small groups remain visible.

- first_audio_played is the server receipt time of the page ACK minus lag_s; it includes return network time and does not establish when sound was heard.
- The page queues audio, adds a 20 ms cushion, and uses a media element. output_latency_s is recorded but is not applied to these timestamps.
- vad_speech_end follows the VAD silence run; the last voiced frame is absent.
- cascade.llm_first_token_ms is overwritten until the first sentence is released; it is not time to first token. Final-flush replies may have no sentence-release stamp.
- cascade.llm_total_ms includes TTS waits and is not pure LLM generation time.
- cascade.stt_ms can be stale between replies; it is never charged to the total.
- Room member cascade timings do not describe the scribe's STT.
- STT, generation and TTS connection overlap. Cascade durations are diagnostics, not additive stages or exposed waits; no reply start timestamp anchors them.
- transcript_arrived is not transcript accepted; director_decided is an endpoint, not a director duration. These diagnostic intervals can overlap the breakdown.
- Saved sim summaries cannot recover stages, means, or first-versus-later splits. The sim does not model the browser audio path.
- Mode uses session metadata. Mixed room and 1:1 interactions are not separated; the current v3 scenarios use one mode per session.

Boundaries not recorded: reply request sent; first content token; first sentence ready; first TTS send; TTS first audio; transcript accepted; floor lock acquired; director start; director end; browser receipt.
